<Warning>
  Pro tier only. This template is included in the **Teams** plan or available as a standalone add-on.
</Warning>

## Overview

Haveno is a marketplace template for selling digital products — SaaS tools, templates, courses, and downloads. Built on top of LaunchKit with multi-vendor support.

## What's Included

- **Seller onboarding** — Stripe Connect Express for marketplace payouts
- **Product listings** — title, description, price, preview, and download URL
- **Buyer flow** — checkout → instant digital delivery via email (Resend)
- **Dashboard** — sellers see revenue, buyers see purchases
- **Search** — full-text product search via Postgres `tsvector`
- **Admin** — approve/reject listings, manage payouts

## Database Schema

```ts
products, sellers, purchases, payouts
```

Three new tables on top of the core LaunchKit schema.

## Getting Started

```bash
npx create-launchkit@latest my-marketplace --template haveno
```

This creates a new LaunchKit project pre-configured with the Haveno schema and pages.

## Stripe Connect Setup

Haveno uses Stripe Connect for marketplace payouts:

1. Enable Stripe Connect in your [Stripe Dashboard](https://dashboard.stripe.com/connect)
2. Add `STRIPE_CONNECT_CLIENT_ID` to your `.env.local`
3. Run `pnpm db:push` to apply the new tables

## Key Files

| Path | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `apps/web/app/(marketplace)/` | All marketplace pages |
| `apps/web/app/api/connect/` | Stripe Connect OAuth routes |
| `packages/database/src/schema/products.ts` | Product schema |
| `packages/email/src/templates/purchase-confirmation.tsx` | Buyer receipt email |

## Customization

Point your AI at `apps/web/app/(marketplace)/` and describe what you want to change. The structure follows the same patterns as the rest of LaunchKit.
